source_document.body:
Anker is leading our Tuesday Green Deals edition this week, with the brand finally launching its Early SOLIX Black Friday Sale that has up to 54% discounts, our exclusive bonus savings code, and FREE gifts. Alongside the included S5000 station deals, you can find offers like the S2000 2,010Wh Power Station with a 400W solar panel exclusively at $1,140 , while other deals start from $530. We also have some spotlight coverage for Velotric’s Fold 1 Plus Folding e-bike at a new $1,199 low , as well as Segway’s Xafari All-Terrain e-bike at a new $1,300 low , the ongoing low for Greenworks’ 40V 12-inch Cordless Snow Shovel, a new Birdfy 4K solar camera, and more. At the bottom of the page is all of yesterday’s hangover deals, like the Yozma IN 10 Pro electric dirt bike at a new $1,614 low , Anker’s eufy early Black Friday security deals , and others.
Head below for other New Green Deals we’ve found today and, of course, Electrek ’s best EV buying and leasing deals . Also, check out the new Electrek Tesla Shop for the best deals on Tesla accessories .
Anker launches 4K solar TrackLight Cam S1 with auto-tracking spotlight, alarm, family recognition, more
Anker’s early SOLIX Black Friday arrives: 2,010Wh S2000 power station + 400W solar panel at exclusive $1,140, more from $530
After the other major backup power brands began their season sale events at the top of the month, Anker followed its usual playbook and arrives with Early Black Friday deals last, complete with up to 54% initial discounts, our exclusive bonus savings code on orders over $1,000, and FREE gifts. While a top pick for me is the newest S5000 Power Station , another notable pick amongst the lineup is the 2026 S2000 2,010Wh Portable Power Station with a 400W solar panel at $1,140 shipped , after using our code 9TO5DEALS5 at checkout, beating Amazon by $60 . Down from $1,700, since July began it’s regularly been available starting as high as $1,376 most days, while discounts have mostly kept things down at $1,200 or $1,160. While it did go as low as $1,100 before mid-July and $1,090 for two days during October’s Prime Day event, this is still a solid $236 markdown off the going rate (and $460 off the MSRP) for the third-lowest price we have tracked. You can also find the standalone station down at $699.99 shipped .
***Note: We have not added the exclusive bonus savings to any of the following prices, so don’t forget to use our code 9TO5DEALS5 at checkout on purchases of $1,000 or more.
Advertisement - scroll for more content
Top picks from Anker’s SOLIX Early Black Friday Sale:
C1000 Gen 2 (1,024Wh) with 200W solar panel: $850 (Reg. $1,200) | $20 less at Amazon
S2000 (2,010Wh) with 400W solar panel: $1,200 (Reg. $1,700)
C2000 Gen 2 (2,048Wh) with 2x 200W solar panels: $1,490 (Reg. $2,400)
S5000 (5,024Wh) power station: $2,600 (Reg. $3,600)
F3800 Plus (3,840Wh) with Smart Home Power Kit: $3,200 (Reg. $4,800)
F3000 (12,288Wh) with 3x expansion batteries: $3,900 (Reg. $6,299)
You can browse the full Anker early Black Friday power station lineup here , including breakdowns of all the bonus extra savings promotions during this sale.
Velotric’s dual sensor + Find My-equipped Fold 1 Plus e-bike hits new $1,199 low for Black Friday ($340 off)
Among Velotric’s Black Friday Sale lineup , we wanted to shine a spotlight on the new low price hitting the Fold 1 Plus Folding e-bike with a FREE mirror ($40 value) down at $1,199 shipped . Down from $1,499, this model mostly saw meager $50 discounts in 2026 and occasional free bundled gear attached, though its summer Prime Day Sale and following July 4th Sale saw it fall to the previous $1,399 low. During November, you’re getting larger-than-ever savings, with a $300 markdown here landing it at the all-time lowest price we have tracked.
You can learn all about this upgraded e-bike’s features in our spotlight coverage of this deal here .
Save $1,100 on Segway’s Xafari all-terrain smart e-bike at a new $1,300 low ahead of Black Friday
Alongside Segway’s early Black Friday savings on the Myon e-bike and F3 e-scooter , the brand is also offering a new low price on its Xafari All-Terrain Electric Dirt Bike down at $1,299.99 shipped . Down from $2,400, since August it has been spending a lot of time discounted to $1,500, which was the lowest previous price we had tracked before this month. Now, you’re getting an additional $200 cut from that previous price ($1,100 total savings off the MSRP), landing it at the best price we have seen to date. There’s also a more premium option in the Xyber Electric Bike down at a return $2,300 low from $3,300. The brand has also expanded its Early Black Friday lineup with member deals to trade in Mileage points for larger-than-normal discounts.
Get more compact winter clearing with Greenworks’ 40V 12-inch cordless snow shovel at its $240 low (Reg. $300)
Amazon is continuing the all-time low price on the Greenworks 40V 12-inch Cordless Electric Snow Shovel with a 4.0Ah battery for $239.99 shipped . While it carries a $300 MSRP direct from Greenworks, this newer model spent a large portion of 2026 out of stock and fell from its higher $330 Amazon pricing to this rate following October’s Prime Day event, where it has remained. This is a prolonged opportunity to prep for winter with a $60 markdown off the going rate for the lowest price we have tracked since launching in August 2025.
First deal hits new Birdfy 4K Solar Bird Watching Cam with lifetime identification down at $120
Through its official Amazon storefront, Birdfy is offering the very first cash savings on its new Bird Cam 2 4K Solar Bird Watching Camera at $119.99 shipped for feeders, baths, and birdhouses. It only just hit the market a little over a month ago, with it having spent the time since keeping to its $150 full price. Now, you’re getting the first discount that cuts $30 off the tag, giving you a solid chance at early holiday shopping for the bird lovers in your life. You can find additional gear from this brand in the official Amazon storefront here .
